prompt:
Create ONE coherent eight-cel animation of the EXACT approved secretary: doze.

Image 1 is the original master illustration and the authority for detailed paint, anatomy and identity. Image 2 is the USER-APPROVED corrected idle family: preserve its broad bob, gentle full cheeks, eye shape and spacing, compact body, costume, palette and fine painterly appearance. Image 3 is an EMPTY four-column two-row layout guide only; never draw its lines. The source character's head width is 30.4% of full STANDING height, crown-to-chin 27%, skirt hem at 66.3%, only 33.7% from hem to soles. Preserve these anatomical relationships when changing pose. No small narrow head, long skinny legs, glossy toy surface or flat simplified cel shading.

One large SQUARE sheet, preferably 3072 x 3072. EXACTLY FOUR columns and TWO rows, eight separated complete full-body cels, ordered left to right across the first row then the second. Roomy gaps and outer margins, identical character scale, fixed camera and shoe/stool baseline within each row. Pure flat cyan #00FFFF in every gap and chair opening. No floor, shadow, glow, effects, text, numbers, guide marks, motion lines or detached pieces. Keep the original fine hair highlights, gray-olive irises, cream skirt pleats, gray-brown cloth texture, delicate gold edging and brown stocking shading. Do not redesign the face or dress.

POSE: She sits on a small plain dark-walnut backless stool with a flat seat and four straight legs, feet close together and knees naturally bent. Keep the SAME anatomical head, torso and limb lengths as the standing reference. Sitting makes the silhouette shorter; do not shrink the head or elongate the seated body. Use the same plain stool design throughout the eight cels.

ACTION: Sit hugging the closed brown book to her chest, become drowsy and make one very small sleepy nod, then wake gently. Head motion pivots naturally at the neck, with consistent face shape; no whole-body rocking. Feet, chair and hugging arms remain fixed.

EIGHT CELS IN READING ORDER: Resting awake; eyelids get heavy; eyes close; chin lowers slightly; smallest sleepy nod at its low point; head gradually returns; eyes open gently; original resting pose.

All cels are drawn together as one consistent loop. Keep the same facial anatomy, hair contour, outfit seams and prop design. Move only what the action requires, through connected shoulder, elbow, wrist and fingers. Head changes must be tiny and gradual; no jump between frame 8 and frame 1. Prioritize identity and frame consistency over big gestures. This is an animation of the existing approved character, not a redesign.
method: Built-in imagegen, one coherent eight-cel sheet; whole-body scale and lower-body registration; no limb warping
review: Production visual review checked character identity, connected limbs and props, and loop continuity; intermediate review reports are retained locally.
generationSource: One coherent eight-cel sheet generated during artwork production; the intermediate sheet is not distributed. The exported PNG cels and playback sequence are stored beside this record.
